pages.title: Welcome, friend
lines: If you are reading this, someone who loves you
wanted you to know: you are not alone.
Thousands of men and women have walked this
road before you, and found their way through.
Change is possible.

pages.title: Naming the struggle
lines: What you have been feeling has a name:
same-sex attraction (SSA).
It is a feeling. It is not who you are.
The world will tell you it is an identity.
We gently say: it is a struggle — and a
struggle can be walked out of, step by step.

pages.title: First steps
lines: STEP ONE — Pray.
You were not meant to carry this alone.
STEP TWO — Listen.
Play tape one of your companion cassette now,
and let the words rest on you as you read.
STEP THREE — Fellowship.
Strugglers who walk together, arrive together.

pages.title: Tape one — a prayer for the journey
lines: (tape hiss)
Lord, you see this child at the doorway,
carrying what they did not choose
and do not have to keep.
Make the crooked places straight before them.
Send them friends of the right kind,
and voices of the right kind,
and the courage to be made new.
We thank you for the work
you are beginning tonight.
(tape ends)

pages.title: You are not alone
lines: Right now — tonight — there are others awake,
walking it out, on the computer in front of you.
Our fellowship hosts a support channel:
#stillstruggling
When you arrive, ask for Rob.
He has been where you are.
